items.title: Elizabeth O'Kelly Kerrigan Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: they'd have, uh, this Negro band, Celestan, played in that band. And I don't remember whether it was his band or whether it was, he was just a member of it.

ctx.x: Well, I'm 52 years old, born and I moved to New Orange when I was three. And the first time I remember anything about jazz was at Pastor Shand, this small Negro band called the Watson Brothers. Started off the homemade instruments and they finally, by going around and serenading people in the evening, and people would go out and either pay them because they liked it or pay them to get away. They managed to acquire enough money to buy a few little, I think they had a banjo and a guitar, and I don't remember…
